$comment: MCP-style tool definitions for every content API endpoint. dynamic/silverstripe-content-api-mcp maps one tool per entry onto the REST endpoint, injecting the X-Silverstripe-Apitoken header. Class payload contracts are discovered at runtime via the schema_class tool.

tools.name: content_auth_session
tools.description: Verify the current API token: member, held permissions, expiry.

tools.name: content_schema_site
tools.description: Discover the site's content API surface: exposed classes with verbs/capabilities, detected integrations (elemental, linkfield, Essentials palette + button labels), environment and whether population endpoints are enabled. Call this first.

tools.name: content_schema_class
tools.description: Get one class's payload contract: fields with types/writability/enum values/token hints, honesty flags (computed: recomputed by the model on save; importOwned: owned by an external feed — both advisory, writes land but are silently overwritten) with an optional note, has_one payload kinds (assetRef|link|recordRef), has_many/many_many writability and, when the relation carries extra join data (a classic many_many_extraFields map or a many_many through join class), an extraFields array naming those fields before you round-trip {"id", "extraFields"} items.

tools.name: content_records_list
tools.description: List records of a class with filtering (Field=value, Field__PartialMatch etc.), sorting (-Field for DESC), pagination and stage selection.

filters.description: Field or Field__Modifier keys; modifiers: ExactMatch, PartialMatch, StartsWith, EndsWith, GreaterThan(OrEqual), LessThan(OrEqual), not, nocase, case

tools.name: content_records_read
tools.description: Read one record by numeric id or external id (ext: prefix). Returns fields (PascalCase, round-trips into writes), relation ids (a many_many with extraFields returns {id, extraFields} per item instead of a bare id) and draft/live stage state.

tools.name: content_records_stage
tools.description: Publish, unpublish or archive a record. Response reports resulting draft/live state. unpublish refuses (409 UNPUBLISH_STRANDS_DESCENDANTS) if the record has any live Hierarchy descendants; archive refuses if it has any in either stage (SiteTree.enforce_strict_hierarchy cascades a delete to every current child in the stage(s) being deleted from) — move/publish them elsewhere first, or pass force to proceed anyway and accept the loss.

mode.description: publish only: takes precedence over the legacy recursive boolean below. subtree publishes the record then every draft Hierarchy child depth-first — the way to publish a moved subtree before unpublishing its old wrapper, see the descendant-cascade guard above.

recursive.description: publish only: legacy shorthand for mode=recursive, kept for backward compatibility. Ignored when mode is present.

force.description: unpublish/archive only: bypass the descendant-cascade guard

tools.name: content_batch
tools.description: Run ordered write operations with per-op results and a summary (agent self-correction contract). atomic=true wraps a transaction and rolls everything back on first failure. On atomic failure, a rolledBack: true result is independently verified before it's reported — every 'created' op is re-checked by id, and so is every 'deleted' op whose mode could actually have reached the draft row (archive, or any mode on an unversioned class; unpublish on a versioned class only touches live, so it's correctly skipped) — an unverified rollback reports 500 ROLLBACK_UNVERIFIED instead, carrying the same results array so every 'created'/'deleted' entry can be checked by hand. Attaching an element to a page whose Elemental config doesn't permit that type fails that op with 422 ELEMENT_NOT_ALLOWED_ON_PAGE.

relations.description: has_one writes: bare id/externalId for a normal relation; a polymorphic has_one (no single target class) rejects a bare id and requires {"class": "...", "id": n} or {"class": "...", "externalId": "..."} — see content_schema_class for which relations are polymorphic

force.description: delete op with mode=unpublish or mode=archive only: bypass the descendant-cascade guard

tools.name: content_compose_page
tools.description: Compose a full page atomically: match/create/convert the page, upsert ordered elements (array order = Sort) with children/relations/link payloads/color tokens, ingest assets with $ref aliases, optionally prune managed elements missing from the payload, publish everything explicitly. Re-POSTing the same payload is idempotent (updates, never duplicates). Any failure rolls the whole request back. An element type the target page's Elemental config (allowed_elements/disallowed_elements) doesn't permit is rejected with 422 ELEMENT_NOT_ALLOWED_ON_PAGE, listing the page's actual allowed types — same check the CMS's own "add element" picker uses.

force.description: Required to convert the site home page

ref.description: Per-request alias usable as {"$ref": …} in element fields

children.description: hasManyRelation: [{externalId, fields, class?}] — owned records under the element's aggregate

relations.description: has_one writes: bare id/externalId for a normal relation; a polymorphic has_one (no single target class) rejects a bare id and requires {"class": "...", "id": n} or {"class": "...", "externalId": "..."} — see content_schema_class for which relations are polymorphic

tools.name: content_asset_upload
tools.description: Upload a file into the asset store with folder placement. Identical content is hash-skipped but ALWAYS returns the full record (existed=true) so relations can be wired on every run. Provide exactly one of "base64" or "filePath" — an MCP client resolves "filePath" locally (on the machine running the MCP host) and never sends the path itself over HTTP, so a caller with only a local file path never has to inline a large binary through its own context.

base64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Mutually exclusive with filePath.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file, read and base64-encoded by the MCP client before the request is sent — the upstream API never sees this field. Mutually exclusive with base64. Not applicable to a direct HTTP caller (curl etc.), which must send base64 itself.

tools.name: content_asset_read
tools.description: Read one asset (numeric id or ext:) with url, hash and filename.

tools.name: content_page_convert
tools.description: Change a page's class via newClassInstance (e.g. Page → BlockPage). Refuses the site home page without force=true.

tools.name: content_page_apply_template
tools.description: Apply an elemental-templates Template's element composition to a page (requires dynamic/silverstripe-elemental-templates).

genericCrud.note: Generic CRUD: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE api/$Model(/$ID) with the same token. Stage-unaware (writes land unpublished on the current stage; no _stage, no ext:). Discover model refs via content_schema_site .crud.models. Auth: POST api/auth/login with email/pwd request vars.
